usage: The word '凍' is used as an adjective to describe cold temperature.
It usually comes before nouns or after the verb '係' (to be) to say it is cold.
You can use '凍' with '好' (very) to emphasize how cold something is.
'凍' can also describe sensations, like feeling cold.
In questions, it can be used with particles like '吖' to ask if something is cold.
